reason: Check graph validation, encrypted transport, conditionals, conflict UI, cancellation and local-first behavior against the approved design.
Check that shared S3 provisioning does not merge the ledger/config envelopes or leak secrets and preserves provider conformance.
Check unified SQLite transactions, schema migrations, local backup boundaries and rollback behavior.
Check single-Compose lifecycle, secret/runtime isolation, data snapshot and new-instance restore evidence.
Check Web-first delivery, SQLite-WASM/OPFS offline behavior, HTTPS/auth boundary and renderer-only API use.
Check Android endpoint reachability, certificate trust and packaged WebView behavior.
Check test/lint/type/build evidence and user-visible failure states for the cross-layer change.
Check end-to-end data flow from Compose storage through S3 transport, local DB, API projection and UI.
Check that claims about IndexedDB persistence and file selection match the documented platform boundary and do not overpromise durability.
Check that automatic-sync claims respect Web/Android background scheduling limits and that the selected identity/S3 boundary is reflected in validation.
Check sync status visibility, accessible interaction states, responsive targets and consistency with the approved task-level UI baseline.
